decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are a low-cost consumable that fits the firm's thermoforming range for dental labs, had their own page through 2019, and cost little to keep listed.
PETG thermoforming blanks are a core material for aligners and splints with steady demand from dental labs, and they had a dedicated page in both years shown.
The UV-curing lacquer is a cheap supporting consumable for lab workflows that was still mentioned in 2019, though it is less prominent than the blanks.
Custom hearing protection earmolds use the firm's custom-device and digital manufacturing strengths for hearing-care retailers, despite the wider earmold line being removed in 2019.
